description.en: The domain name of the image repository.

description.zh:
镜像仓库附加参数。包含：

- **namespace**：命名空间
- **authToken**：授权token
description.en:
The additional parameters of the image repository. The value of this parameter contains the following fields:

*   **namespace**: the namespace
*   **authToken**: the authorization token

The network type. Valid values:

*   **1**: Internet
*   **2**: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
The number of days during which assets can be retained.

The type of the protocol. Valid values:

*   **1**: HTTP
*   **2**: HTTPS
The region ID of the image repository.
The IP address of the image repository.
The alias of the image repository.

description.zh:
镜像仓库类型。取值：

- **CI/CD**：jenkins环境
description.en:
The type of the image repository. Valid values:

*   **CI/CD**: Jenkins

The version of the image repository. Default value: -. Valid values:

*   **-**: the default version
*   **V1**: V1.0
*   **V2**: V2.0
The source IP address of the request.
The number of images that can be scanned per hour.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-jenkins-image-registry --registry-name testRepo --registry-type CI/CD --registry-version V1 --protocol-type 1 --net-type 1 --vpc-id vpc-2ze4aoqgeu51ydfb80000 --registry-host-ip 114.55.XXX.XXX --domain-name example.com --user-name RegistryUser --password Harbor00000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --white-list 192.168.XXX.XXX --trans-per-hour 30 --extra-param namespace_:_aa_,_authToken_:_aa --persistence-day 30 --source-ip 41.121.XXX.XXX --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
